dimensions.assessment: Involves federal agencies, state and tribal governments, forest landowners, and conservation organizations.

dimensions.assessment: Carries out specific pilot restoration projects, grants, and research partnerships.
dimensions.evidence: establish and carry out 5 pilot projects in national forests to restore white oak

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes funding subject to appropriations and advance fund allocations for grant management.

dimensions.assessment: Creates new coalitions, pilot forestry programs, grant mechanisms, research partnerships, and national nursery strategies.
dimensions.evidence: establish a non-regulatory program to be known as the White Oak and Upland Oak Habitat Regeneration Program

card.summary: The Fix Our Forests Act establishes new requirements and programs for managing federal, state, tribal, and private lands to reduce wildfire risks, expedite environmental reviews, and improve forest health. It creates an interagency Fireshed Center to predict and assess fires, establishes emergency management projects in high-risk firesheds, reforms litigation procedures for forest management projects, creates community wildfire risk reduction and research programs, expands utilities' ability to manage vegetation near power lines, and provides casualty assistance for wildland firefighters.
